messages:
Lina: quick q from today's all-hands: if a region goes from healthy -> 0 GPUs due to supply/maintenance, what's the immediate customer-visible path? spill, degrade, or errors? cc @Marco

Marco (Infra): plan is: 1) short absorb + 250ms queue smoothing, 2) soft-spill to nearest-region within latency budget, 3) model-variant degrade (quantized/smaller), 4) 503 with Retry-After as last resort. we'll publish a compact playbook with thresholds.

Devon (SRE): saw this in the night run: when we spilled APAC->US, median latency +40ms, p95 +120ms; tail bursty for ~0.5% of requests. log snippet:

```
2026-03-23T21:10:01Z spot: reclaim 100% nodepool
2026-03-23T21:10:02Z queue.p95 310ms -> spill->us-west1
2026-03-23T21:10:03Z routing: retry->us-west1
```

Kelly (Product): product teams want a console toggle to opt-out of cross-region spill and an estimated latency penalty shown when enabling it.

Marco (Infra): agree on toggle + show historical median penalty estimate. ETA: backend next sprint, UI the sprint after.

AuditBot: Note: customers with residency opt-out require audit events for each spill (origin, dest, timestamp, request ids).

Devon (SRE): action items: add telemetry keys spill.reason and spill.dest_region, add alert if spill.rate > 0.4% sustained 5m, include 90s cooldown after failed burst attempts to avoid thrash.

Marco (Infra): I'll draft the playbook and post by COB Friday with concrete numbers (suggested thresholds: spill if region capacity <12% OR queue.p95 >400ms; degrade only if spill blocked or cross-region latency >150ms).

Lina: thanks — can we get a 1-paragraph runbook for oncall asap?

Devon (SRE): yes, will drop a 1-pager in #eng-oncall with a short checklist and quick rollback commands.

OpsBot: Follow-up sync scheduled: "Region Fallback Playbook" Mon 9:30 PT. Invite sent.

Lina: appreciate the clarity, thanks everyone. :pray:
